scope: 40 fixed-frame native-admitted SECURITY findings; minimum 30 reference-decided; primary actionable precision only.

review_process.reconciliation: Identical first-pass labels only; disagreements remain UNCLEAR; no semantic retries.

inference_limit: Nominal unclustered interval; no cluster-adjusted inference. AI-only reference.

sampling.order: Fixed repository rank; deterministic native finding order within each repository. Stop at exactly40 admitted eligible alerts before any reference labels are opened.
sampling.post_source_changes: Bundled registrations bind identical engine, frame and selection. Local continuity/preflight receipts record preservation before reference review; these are local protocol observations, not independent temporal attestation.
sampling.exposure_declaration: The original registration records target_source_access=false and labels_seen=false before the final engine freeze. Prior-exposure exclusion is a registered local control, not an outside-human attestation.

known_tp_regression.scope: Exposed development replay, separate from the fresh held-out score.

after_reference: This cohort is now exposed; preserve these original labels and score. Any subsequent repairs require separate regression reporting and a fresh cohort for a new held-out claim.
